# Game Idea

**Asteroid Escape** – A top‑down HTML canvas game. The player pilots a spaceship that constantly moves forward, can rotate and thrust to dodge randomly spawning asteroids. Fuel slowly drains; colliding with an asteroid or running out of fuel ends the game.

1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game
2: // Canvas with id="game" in the HTML
3: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
6: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
7: 
8: // Ship state
9: // Sound assets
10: const thrustSound = new Audio('thrust.mp3');
11: thrustSound.loop = true;
12: const crashSound = new Audio('crash.mp3');
13: let thrustPlaying = false;
14: let crashPlayed = false;
15: // Add star field for background
16: const STAR_COUNT = 100;
17: const stars = [];
18: function initStars() {
19:   for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
20:     stars.push({
21:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
22:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
23:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
24:     });
25:   }
26: }
27: initStars();
28: const ship = {
29:   x: canvas.width / 2,
30:   y: canvas.height / 2,
31:   angle: 0,
32:   vx: 0,
33:   vy: 0,
34:   radius: 10,
35:   thrust: 0.1,
36:   rotateSpeed: 0.07,
37: };
38: 
39: let fuel = 100; // percent
40: let asteroids = [];
41: let gameOver = false;
42: let lastSpawn = 0;
43: 
44: function spawnAsteroid() {
45:   // Add random rotation angle and speed for asteroid
46:   const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
47:   const rotSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02;
48:   const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
49:   let x, y, vx, vy;
50:   const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 1.5;
51:   switch (edge) {
52:     case 0: // top
53:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width; y = -20; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; vy = speed; break;
54:     case 1: // right
55:       x = canvas.width + 20; y = Math.random() * canvas.height; vx = -speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; break;
56:     case 2: // bottom
57:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width; y = canvas.height + 20; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; vy = -speed; break;
58:     case 3: // left
59:       x = -20; y = Math.random() * canvas.height; vx = speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; break;
60:   }
61:   asteroids.push({x, y, vx, vy, r: 15 + Math.random() * 20, angle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, rotSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02});
62: }
63: 
64: function update(dt) {
65:   if (gameOver) return;
66:   // Controls
67:   if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= ship.rotateSpeed;
68:   if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += ship.rotateSpeed;
69:   const thrusting = keys['ArrowUp'] && fuel > 0;
70:   if (thrusting) {
71:     ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
72:     ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
73:     fuel -= dt * 0.01; // fuel consumption
74:     if (!thrustPlaying) {
75:       thrustSound.currentTime = 0;
76:       thrustSound.play();
77:     }
78:   } else {
79:     thrustSound.pause();
80:   }
81:   // Move ship
82:   ship.x += ship.vx;
83:   ship.y += ship.vy;
84:   // Screen wrap for ship
85:   if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += canvas.width;
86:   if (ship.x > canvas.width) ship.x -= canvas.width;
87:   if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += canvas.height;
88:   if (ship.y > canvas.height) ship.y -= canvas.height;
89:   // Update asteroids
90:   for (let a of asteroids) {
91:     a.x += a.vx;
92:     a.y += a.vy;
93:     a.angle += a.rotSpeed;
94:     // wrap
95:     if (a.x < -30) a.x += canvas.width + 60;
96:     if (a.x > canvas.width + 30) a.x -= canvas.width + 60;
97:     if (a.y < -30) a.y += canvas.height + 60;
98:     if (a.y > canvas.height + 30) a.y -= canvas.height + 60;
99:   }
100:   // Collision detection
101:   for (let a of asteroids) {
102:     const dx = a.x - ship.x;
103:     const dy = a.y - ship.y;
104:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
105:     if (dist < a.r + ship.radius) {
106:       gameOver = true;
107:       if (!crashPlayed) {
108:         crashSound.currentTime = 0;
109:         crashSound.play();
110:         crashPlayed = true;
111:       }
112:     }
113:   }
114:   // Fuel out
115:   if (fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
116:   // Spawn new asteroids periodically
117:   if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > 2000) {
118:     spawnAsteroid();
119:     lastSpawn = performance.now();
120:   }
121: }
122: 
123: function draw() {
124:   // Background gradient
125:   const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
126:   grad.addColorStop(0, '#000020');
127:   grad.addColorStop(1, '#000010');
128:   ctx.fillStyle = grad;
129:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
130: 
131:   // Stars
132:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
133:   for (let s of stars) {
134:     ctx.beginPath();
135:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
136:     ctx.fill();
137:   }
138: 
139: 
140:   // Ship
141:   ctx.save();
142:   ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
143:   ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
144: ctx.beginPath();
145:     ctx.moveTo(15, 0);
146:     ctx.lineTo(-10, -7);
147:     ctx.lineTo(-10, 7);
148:     ctx.closePath();
149:     // Ship gradient
150:     const shipGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 2, 0, 0, 12);
151:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00ffff');
152:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0066ff');
153:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
154:     ctx.fill();
155:     // Optional thrust flame
156:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && fuel > 0) {
157:       ctx.beginPath();
158:       ctx.moveTo(-12, 0);
159:       ctx.lineTo(-20, -5);
160:       ctx.lineTo(-20, 5);
161:       ctx.closePath();
162:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
163:       ctx.fill();
164:     }
165:   ctx.restore();
166:     // Asteroids with gradient shading and rotation
167:     for (let a of asteroids) {
168:       ctx.save();
169:       ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
170:       ctx.rotate(a.angle);
171:       const gradA = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, a.r * 0.2, 0, 0, a.r);
172:       gradA.addColorStop(0, '#888888');
173:       gradA.addColorStop(1, '#222222');
174:       ctx.fillStyle = gradA;
175:       ctx.beginPath();
176:       ctx.arc(0, 0, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
177:       ctx.fill();
178:       ctx.restore();
179:     }
180:   // UI
181:   ctx.fillStyle = 'lime';
182:   ctx.font = '16px monospace';
183:   ctx.fillText('Fuel: ' + Math.max(0, fuel).toFixed(0) + '%', 10, 20);
184:   if (gameOver) {
185:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
186:     ctx.font = '48px monospace';
187:     ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', canvas.width / 2 - 150, canvas.height / 2);
188:   }
189: }
190: 
191: let lastTime = 0;
192: function loop(timestamp) {
193:   const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
194:   lastTime = timestamp;
195:   update(dt);
196:   draw();
197:   if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
198: }
199: requestAnimationFrame(loop);
